REVISE

1. consistent (final reply vs chip 6). In the script, the `c1` choice fills `{list}` in chip 6's fixed text. With the second `c1` choice ("Exempt only investigate and add-product-command"), the copied reply tells the implementer two things that conflict. They are to "Put the three ceremony skill names in one const in transitions.rs. size.rs builds its .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/ entries from it", and also that "protected() exempts a second const, EXEMPT_SKILLS (investigate, add-product-command)". Under that choice every other skill stays protected, including new ones. A fixed three-name ceremony const cannot express that, so size.rs built from it would leave new skills small. That contradicts the choice's own reply. The rewrite must give chip 6 a per-choice variant. For the exempt-only choice, size.rs should be built from the exempt const (everything under the skills folders forces standard except the exempt names). Then re-read the assembled reply for all three `c1` choices, and for each `c3`, `c5` and `c6` choice that changes it.
